Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.af: Kies 'n voorstel vir die beste pasmaat, of tik klaar en voeg stad/poskode hieronder by.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.zu: Khetha isiphakamiso sokufanisa okungcono kakhulu, noma qedela ukuthayipha bese wengeza idolobha/ikhodi yeposi ngezansi.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.xh: Khetha ingcebiso yowona mdlalo ubalaseleyo, okanye ugqibezele ukuchwetheza kwaye wongeze isixeko / ikhowudi yeposi ngezantsi.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.st: Khetha tlhahiso bakeng sa papali e ntle ka ho fetisisa, kapa qeta ho ngola 'me u kenye toropo / khoutu ea poso ka tlase.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.nso: Kgetha tšhišinyo ya papadi ye kaone, goba o fetše go thaepa gomme o oketše khoutu ya toropo / poso ka fase.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.tn: Tlhopha kakantsho ya tshwano e e gaisang, kgotsa fetsa go thaepa o bo o tsenya toropo / khoutu ya poso fa tlase.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.ts: Hlawula xiringanyeto xa ku fambisana lokunene, kutani u heta ku thayipa u engetela khodi ya doroba / ya poso laha hansi.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.ve: Khethani nyeletshedzo ya u ṱangana ha khwine, kana ni fhedzise u thaipha ni engedze ḓorobo / khoudu ya poswo afho fhasi.
Pick a suggestion for the best match, or.ss: Khetsa siphakamiso sekuhambisana lokuhle kakhulu, noma cedzela kuthayipha bese wengeta lidolobha / ikhodi yeposi ngetansi.

Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.af: Beautonomi kan nie stootwaarskuwings stuur totdat jy kennisgewings in jou foon se instellings toelaat nie.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.zu: Beautonomi ayikwazi ukuthumela izexwayiso kuze kube yilapho uvumela izaziso kuzilungiselelo zefoni yakho.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.xh: Beautonomi ayikwazi ukuthumela izilumkiso zokutyhala de uvumele izaziso kuseto lwefowuni yakho.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.st: Beautonomi ha e khone ho romela litlhokomeliso ho fihlela u lumella litemoso ho litlhophiso tsa fono ea hau.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.nso: Beautonomi ga e kgone go romela ditemošo tša go kgorometša go fihlela o dumelela ditsebišo ka gare ga dipeakanyo tša mogala wa gago.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.tn: Beautonomi ga e kgone go romela ditsiboso tsa push go fitlha o letla dikitsiso mo diseting tsa founo ya gago.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.ts: Beautonomi a wu nge swi koti ku rhumela switsundzuxo swa ku susumeta ku kondza u pfumelela switiviso eka swiyimiso swa foni ya wena.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.ve: Beautonomi a i koni u rumela nḓivhadzo dza u sukumedza u swikela ni tshi tendela nḓivhadzo kha zwishumiswa zwa founu yaṋu.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.ss: Beautonomi ayikhoni kutfumela tecwayiso te-push uze uvumele tatiso kumasethingi efoni yakho.

You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.af: Jy moet ten minste 13 wees om Beautonomi te gebruik. Identiteitsverifikasie en uitbetalings vereis 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.zu: Kufanele okungenani ube neminyaka eyi-13 ukusebenzisa Beautonomi. Ukuqinisekisa ubuwena nezinkokhelo kudinga okungu-18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.xh: Kufuneka ube neminyaka eli-13 ubuncinci ukusebenzisa Beautonomi. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesazisi kunye neentlawulo zifuna i-18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.st: O tlameha ho ba le bonyane lilemo tse 13 ho sebelisa Beautonomi. Netefatso ea boitsebiso le litefo li hloka 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.nso: O swanetše go ba bonnyane bja mengwaga ye 13 go šomiša Beautonomi. Netefatšo ya boitšhupo le ditefelo di nyaka 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.tn: O tshwanetse go nna bonnye dingwaga di le 13 go dirisa Beautonomi. Netefatso ya boitshupo le dituelo di tlhoka 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.ts: U fanele ku va na kwalomu ka 13 ku tirhisa Beautonomi. Ku tiyisisiwa ka vutitivisi na ku hakela swi lava 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.ve: U fanela u vha na miṅwaha i si fhasi ha 13 u itela u shumisa Beautonomi. U khwaṱhisedzwa ha vhuṱanzi na u badela zwi ṱoḓa 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.ss: Kufanele ube neminyaka lengu-13 kute usebentise Beautonomi. Kucinisekisa bunikati kanye nekukhokha kudzinga 18+.

Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.tn: Tsenya karata ya tuelo mo Mekgweng ya Tuelo, o bo o boela fano go tlhabolola sekoloto sa gago sa botokololo.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.ts: Engetelani khadi ro hakela eka Tindlela to Hakela, kutani u tlhelela laha ku pfuxeta xibalo xa wena xa xirho.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.ve: Engedzani garaṱa ya mbadelo kha Nḓila dza Mbadelo, nga murahu ni vhuyelele fhano u itela u khwinisa mbadelo yaṋu ya muraḓo.

Your account will be disabled immediatel.af: Jou rekening sal onmiddellik gedeaktiveer word. Jy kan enige tyd heraktiveer deur weer aan te meld.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.zu: I-akhawunti yakho izokhutshazwa ngokushesha. Ungaphinda wenze kusebenze noma nini ngokungena futhi.

Your account will be disabled immediatel.st: Ak'haonte ea hau e tla koaloa hanghang. O ka bula hape neng kapa neng ka ho kena hape.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.nso: Akhaonto ya gago e tla šitišwa ka pela. O ka tsenya tirišong gape nako efe goba efe ka go tsena gape.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.tn: Akhaonto ya gago e tla thibelwa ka bonako. O ka simolola gape nako nngwe le nngwe ka go tsena gape.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.ts: Akhawunti ya wena yi ta pfariwa hi ku hatlisa. U nga ha tlhela u tirha nkarhi wihi na wihi hi ku nghena nakambe.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.ve: Account yanu i do thivhelwa nga u tavhanya. Ni nga dovha na shuma tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga u dzhena hafhu.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.ss: I-akhawunti yakho itawucinywa ngekushesha. Ungaphindze uvule noma nini ngekuphindze ungene ngemvume.

Finish payment in the browser. Once done.st: Qetella ho lefa sebatli. Ha u se u qetile, e-ea ho Account → Botho ho bona moralo oa hau o mocha.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.nso: Qeta tefo ka sephephediši. Ge o šetše o dirile, eya go Akhaonto → Boleloko go bona leano la gago le lefsa.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.tn: Fetsa tuelo mo sebatling. Fa o sena go fetsa, ya kwa Akhaontong → Botokololo go bona thulaganyo ya gago e ntšha.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.ts: Hetisa ku hakela eka browser. Loko se u endlile, nghena eka Account → Membership ku vona pulani ya wena leyintshwa.

Finish payment in the browser. Once done.ss: Cedzela kukhokha kusiphequluli. Uma sewucedzile, iya ku-Akhawunti → Bulunga kute ubone luhlelo lwakho lolusha.

Clients can only book slots within these.ss: Bakhasimende bangabhuka kuphela ngaphakatsi kwalemahora. Chafata lusuku kute ulivule/lucime, bese usetha tikhathi.

If you completed payment, it may take a.nso: Ge o qeditše go lefa, go ka tšea nako ye kopana go netefatša. Mpshafatša odara ye ka pela.
If you completed payment, it may take a.tn: Fa o qeditse go lefa, go ka tsaya nako e kgakololo go netefatsa. Ntšhwafatsa odara eno ka bonako.
If you completed payment, it may take a.ts: Loko u hetile ku hakela, swi nga teka xin'wana ku tiyisisa. Pfuxeta odara leyi ku nga ri khale.
If you completed payment, it may take a.ve: Arali no fhedza u badela, zwi nga dzhia vhukati u khwaṱhisedza. Pfuxani odara iyi nga u fhira.
If you completed payment, it may take a.ss: Uma usucedze kukhokha, kungatsatsa sikhashana kucinisekisa. Vuselela le odara masinyane.

Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.af: Gebruik Google Calendar, Outlook op die web, of die kalenderlêer (.ics)-opsie op hierdie skerm.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.zu: Sebenzisa i-Google Calendar, i-Outlook kuwebhu, noma inketho yefayela lekhalenda (.ics) kulesi skrini.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.xh: Sebenzisa i-Google Calendar, i-Outlook kwiwebhu, okanye ukhetho lwefayile yekhalenda (.ics) kwesi skrini.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.st: Sebelisa Google Calendar, Outlook inthaneteng, kapa khetho ea faele ea almanaka (.ics) skrineng sena.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.nso: Šomiša Google Calendar, Outlook inthaneteng, goba kgetho ya faele ya almanaka (.ics) skrineng se.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.tn: Dirisa Google Calendar, Outlook mo inthaneteng, kgotsa tlhopho ya faele ya almanaka (.ics) mo skrineng se.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.ts: Tirhisa Google Calendar, Outlook eka web, kumbe xihlawulekisi xa fayili ya kalendara (.ics) eka xikirini lexi.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.ve: Shumisani Google Calendar, Outlook kha web, kana khetho ya faele ya kalenda (.ics) kha skrini iyi.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.ss: Sebentisa i-Google Calendar, i-Outlook kuwebhu, noma inkhetfo yefayela yekhalenda (.ics) kulesi skrini.

This moves the entire group to a new dat.af: Dit skuif die hele groep na 'n nuwe datum en tyd. Beskikbaarheid word bevestig wanneer jy stoor.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.zu: Lokhu lihambisa iqembu lonke kusuka lusuku nesikhathi esisha. Ukutholakala kuqinisekiswa lapho ulondoloza.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.xh: Oku kuhambisa iqela lonke kumhla nexesha elitsha. Ukufumaneka kuqinisekiswa xa ugcina.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.st: Sena se isa sehlopha kaofela letsatsing le nako e ncha. Ho fumaneha ho netefatsoa ha o boloka.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.nso: Se se gogela sehlopha ka moka letšatšing le nako ye mpsha. Go hwetšwa go netefatšwa ge o boloka.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.tn: Se se gogela sehlopha tsotlhe letsatsing le nako e ntšha. Go bonala go netefatswa fa o boloka.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.ts: Leswi swi rhundza ntlawa hinkwawo ku ya eka siku na nkarhi wuntshwa. Ku kumeka ku tiyisisiwa loko u hlayisa.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.ve: Hezwi zwi susa tshigwada hinkwatsho u ya ḓuvha na naho ntswa. U wanala u khwaṱhisedzwa musi ni vhulunga.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.ss: Lokhu lihambisa sigaba sonkhe lusuku nesikhati lesisha. Ukutfolakala kucinisekiswa lapho ugcina.

Add a shared time slot, service, team me.af: Voeg 'n gedeelde tydgleuf, diens, spanlid en aanvanklike deelnemers met kalenderkontroles by.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.zu: Engeza isikhathi esabiwe, isevisi, ilungu leqembu, nabahlanganyeli bokuqala nokuhlola ikhalenda.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.xh: Yongeza isithuba sesikhathi esabiweyo, inkonzo, ilungu leqela, nabahlanganyeli bokuqala nokujonga ikhalenda.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.st: Kenya nako e arolelanoang, litšebeletso, setho sa sehlopha, le bamameli ba pele ka tlhahlobo ea almanaka.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.nso: Oketša nako ye e abelanwago, tirelo, setho sa sehlopha, le bamameli ba mathomo ka ditekolo tša almanaka.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.tn: Oketsa nako e e abelanwang, tirelo, setho sa sehlopha, le bamameli ba ntlha ka ditekolo tsa almanaka.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.ts: Engetela nkarhi wo avelana, vukorhokeri, xirho xa ntlawa, na vahlangi va sungula hi ku kambela kalendara.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.ve: Engedzani naho yo avelanaho, tshumelo, tshithu tsha tshigwada, na vhahlangi vha u thoma nga u sedza kalenda.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.ss: Faka sikhathi lesabiwe, insita, silungu sesigaba, nebahlanganyeli bokuqala ngekuhlola ikhalenda.

Create a group session for bridal partie.af: Skep 'n groepsessie vir henpartye, geleenthede, gesinne of gedeelde diensafsprake.
Create a group session for bridal partie.zu: Dala iseshini yeqembu yama-party ezosishada, imicimbi, imindeni, noma izikhathi zesevisi ezabiwe.
Create a group session for bridal partie.xh: Yenza iseshini yeqela yama-party ezosishada, imicimbi, iintsapho, okanye iindibano zeenkonzo ezabiweyo.
Create a group session for bridal partie.st: Theha sešene sa sehlopha bakeng sa li-party tsa manyalo, liketsahalo, lilemo, kapa likopano tsa litšebeletso tse arolelanoang.
Create a group session for bridal partie.nso: Hlola sešene ya sehlopha bakeng sa diparty tša manyalo, ditiragalo, malapa, goba dipeeletšo tša tirelo tše di abelanwago.
Create a group session for bridal partie.tn: Tlhama sešene ya sehlopha bakeng sa diparty tsa manyalo, ditiragalo, malapa, kgotsa dipeelano tsa ditirelo tse di abelanwang.
Create a group session for bridal partie.ts: Endla nkarhi wa ntlawa wa swipati swa u nyula, swiendlakalo, mindyangu, kumbe swihlangano swa vukorhokeri leswi avelanaka.
Create a group session for bridal partie.ve: Itani nkarhi wa tshigwada wa diparty dza u nyula, zwiitea, miṱa, kana u vhewa ha tshumelo dzo avelanaho.
Create a group session for bridal partie.ss: Dala iseshini yesigaba yemigubho yemishado, imicimbi, imindeni, noma tikhathi tetinsita letabiwe.

The notification could not be delivered..af: Die kennisgewing kon nie afgelewer word nie. Gaan die kliënt se kontakbesonderhede na en probeer weer.
The notification could not be delivered..zu: Isaziso asikwazanga ukulethwa. Hlola imininingwane yokuxhumana yekhasimende bese uzama futhi.
The notification could not be delivered..xh: Isaziso asikwazanga ukuthunyelwa. Jonga iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelo zomthengi uze uzame kwakhona.
The notification could not be delivered..st: Tsebiso ha e a fihla. Sheba lintlha tsa ho ikopanya tsa moreki ebe u leka hape.
The notification could not be delivered..nso: Tsebišo ga e a fihla. Lekola dintlha tša go ikopanya tša moreki gomme o leke gape.
The notification could not be delivered..tn: Tsebiso ga e a fihla. Lebelela dintlha tsa go ikopanya tsa moreki mme o leke gape.
The notification could not be delivered..ts: Xitiviso a xi kotanga ku fika. Languta vuxokoxoko bya vuxaka bya xixaxani u ringeta nakambe.
The notification could not be delivered..ve: Tshivhudzo a tshi kona u fika. Sedzani zwiitisi zwa u kwamana zwa rengi ni lingedze hafhu.
The notification could not be delivered..ss: Isaziso asikwati kuletfwa. Hlola imininingwane yekuxhumana yekhasimende bese uyazama futsi.

Inherited days follow your location oper.af: Oorgeërfde dae volg jou ligging se bedryfsure. Voeg 'n weeklikse skof by om pasgemaakte ure te stel.
Inherited days follow your location oper.zu: Izinsuku ezitholiwe zilandela amahora okusebenza endaweni yakho. Engeza ishifi yeviki ukuze usethe amahora angokwezifiso.
Inherited days follow your location oper.xh: Iintsuku ezi fumana zilandela iiyure zokusebenza kwendawo yakho. Yongeza ishifi yeveki ukuze usete iiyure ezikhethekileyo.
Inherited days follow your location oper.st: Matsatsi a fumanoeng a latela lihora tsa mosebetsi wa sebaka sa hau. Kenya shift ea beke ho beha lihora tse ikhethileng.
Inherited days follow your location oper.nso: Matšatši ao a amogelwago a latela dihora tša go šoma tša lefelo la gago. Oketša shift ya beke go bea dihora tša gago.
Inherited days follow your location oper.tn: Malatsi a a amogelwang a latela dihora tsa go dira tsa lefelo la gago. Oketsa shift ya beke go bea dihora tse di kgethegileng.
Inherited days follow your location oper.ts: Masiku lama amukeriwaka ya landela tiawara ta ntirho ta ndhawu ya wena. Engetela shift ya vhiki ku veka tiawara leti hlawulekeke.
Inherited days follow your location oper.ve: Ḓuvha dzo amukelwaho dzi tevhela tiawara dza mushumo kha fhethu haṋu. Engedzani shift ya vhiki u itela u veka tiawara dzo khetheaho.
Inherited days follow your location oper.ss: Emalanga laphumako alandela emahora ekusebenta endzaweni yakho. Faka ishifi yeviki kute usete emahora langekhetsekile.

Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.af: Wenk: Vir veelvuldige pryse op een diens, kies Basic en gebruik besprekingsopsies hieronder.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.zu: Ithiphu: Ukuze uthole amanani amaningi kuyinsiza eyodwa, khetha i-Basic bese usebenzisa izinketho zokubhuka ngezansi.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.xh: Ingcebiso: Ukuba unamaxabiso amaninzi kwinkonzo enye, khetha i-Basic uze usebenzise ukhetho lokubhukisha ngezansi.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.st: Keletso: Bakeng sa litheko tse ngata litšebeletsong e le 'ngoe, khetha Basic mme o sebelise likhetho tsa booking ka tlase.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.nso: Keletšo: Bakeng sa ditheko tše dintši go tirelo e tee, kgetha Basic gomme o šomiše dikgetho tša booking ka fase.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.tn: Tlhabo-botlhale: Bakeng sa ditlhwatlhwa tse dintsi mo tirelong e le nngwe, tlhopha Basic mme o dirise ditlhopho tsa booking fa fase.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.ts: Xitsundzuxo: Eka minxavo yo tala eka vukorhokeri byin'we, hlawula Basic u tirhisa swihlawulekisi swa ku veka laha hansi.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.ve: Nyeletshedzo: U itela mitengo yo fhulufhedzaho kha tshumelo imwe, khethani Basic ni shumise khetho dza u vhiga afha fhasi.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.ss: Lusito: Uma unentengo lenyingi kuyinsita yinye, khetsa i-Basic bese usebentisa tinkhetfo tekubhuka ngezansi.

Set the price and duration for this vari.af: Stel die prys en duur vir hierdie variant. Dit verskyn onder die ouerdiens by bespreking.
Set the price and duration for this vari.zu: Setha intengo nesikhathi sale variant. Ivela ngaphansi kwesevisi engumzali lapho ubhukha.
Set the price and duration for this vari.xh: Misela ixabiso nexesha lale variant. Ibonakala ngaphantsi kwenkonzo engumzali xa ubhukisha.
Set the price and duration for this vari.st: Beha theko le nako ea variant ena. E hlaha tlasa litšebeletso ea motsoali ha u beha.
Set the price and duration for this vari.nso: Bea theko le nako ya variant ye. E bonala ka fase ga tirelo ya motšhidi ge o beela.
Set the price and duration for this vari.tn: Bea tlhwatlhwa le nako ya variant eno. E bonala fa tlase ga tirelo ya motlhabi fa o beela.
Set the price and duration for this vari.ts: Veka nxavo na nkarhi wa variant leyi. Yi humelela ehansi ka vukorhokeri bya vatswari loko u veka.
Set the price and duration for this vari.ve: Vheani mutengo na tshifhinga tsha variant iyi. I vhonala fhasi ha tshumelo ya muhulu musi ni tshi vhiga.
Set the price and duration for this vari.ss: Seta intengo nesikhati sale variant. Ivela ngaphansi kwensita leyimzali lapho ubhukha.

When set, the campaign is saved as sched.af: Indien gestel, word die veldtog as geskeduleer gestoor; tik Stuur op die lys om af te lewer (dieselfde as web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.zu: Uma kusethiwe, ikhampeni ilondolozwa njengohleliwe; thepha Thumela ohlwini ukuze uyithumele (njengakuwebhu).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.xh: Xa kusetyiwe, ikhampeni igcinwa njengohleliweyo; cofa Thumela kuluhlu ukuze uyithumele (njengakuwebhu).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.st: Ha e behilwe, lets'olo le bolokoa e le le hlophisitsoeng; tlanya Romela lethathong ho romella (joalo ka web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.nso: Ge e beilwe, lets'olo le bolokwa e le le hlophišitšwego; tlanya Romela lenaneong go romela (bjoalo ka web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.tn: Fa e beilwe, lets'olo le bolokwa e le le rulaganyeditsweng; tlanya Romela mo lenaneng go romela (fano le web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.ts: Loko swi vekiwile, khampeni yi hlayisiwa tanihi leyi hleleriwaka; koma Rhumela eka nxaxamelo ku rhumela (fana na web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.ve: Musi zwi vheiwa, khampeni i vhulungwa tanaho i hleleriwaho; dzhianani Rumela kha mutevhe wa u rumela (fana na web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.ss: Uma kusetjwe, khempeni igcinwa njengohleliwe; chafata Thumela ohlwini kute uyithumele (njengakuwebhu).

Search above, use your location, or drop.af: Soek bo, gebruik jou ligging, of los 'n speld. Gestoorde adresse verskyn hier vir vinnige hergebruik.
Search above, use your location, or drop.zu: Sesha ngenhla, sebenzisa indawo yakho, noma wehle iphinhi. Amakheli alondoloziwe avele lapha ukuze uwasebenzise ngokushesha.
Search above, use your location, or drop.xh: Khangela ngasentla, sebenzisa indawo yakho, okanye wehle iphinhi. Amakheli agciniweyo avele apha ukuze uwasebenzise ngokukhawuleza.
Search above, use your location, or drop.st: Batla ka holimo, sebelisa sebaka sa hau, kapa beha pine. Liaterese tse bolokiloeng li hlaha mona bakeng sa ho sebelisa hape ka potlako.
Search above, use your location, or drop.nso: Nyaka ka godimo, šomiša lefelo la gago, goba bea pine. Diaterese tše di bolokilwego di bonala fao bakeng sa go di šomiša gape ka pela.
Search above, use your location, or drop.tn: Batla fa godimo, dirisa lefelo la gago, kgotsa bea pine. Diaterese tse di bolokilweng di bonala fa bakeng sa go di dirisa gape ka bonako.
Search above, use your location, or drop.ts: Lava laha henhla, tirhisa ndhawu ya wena, kumbe veka pin. Tiadirese leti hlayisiweke ti humelela laha ku tirhisiwa hi ku hatlisa nakambe.
Search above, use your location, or drop.ve: Sedzani nga heha, shumisani fhethu haṋu, kana vheani pin. Dziadresi dzo vhulungwaho dzi vhonala afha u itela u dzi shumisa hafhu hi u fhira.
Search above, use your location, or drop.ss: Sesha ngenhla, sebentisa indzawo yakho, noma wehle iphinhi. Emakheli lagciniwe avele lapha kute uwasebentise ngokushesha.

Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.af: Tik Bekyk om 'n opgelaaide dokument oop te maak. Outomatiese kontroles sluit dalk nie 'n aflaaibare lêer in nie.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.zu: Thepha Buka ukuze uvule idokhumenti elayishiwe. Ukuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo kungase kungabi nefayela elingalayishwa.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.xh: Cofa Jonga ukuze uvule uxwebhu olulayishiweyo. Ukuhlolwa okuzenzekelayo kungase kungabi nefayile elandwayo.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.st: Tlanya Sheba ho bula tokomane e kentsoeng. Ditekolo tsa boiketsetso li ka se kenyelle faele e ka khoasoang.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.nso: Tlanya Lebelela go bula tokumente ye e tsentšwego. Ditekolo tša go iketla di ka no se akaretše faele ye e ka khoaswago.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.tn: Tlanya Lebelela go bula tokumente e e tsentsweng. Ditekolo tsa go iketla di ka se akaretse faele e e ka khoaswang.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.ts: Koma Languta ku pfula xitokumente lexi layisiweke. Swikambelo swo tirhisa hi xoxe swi nga ha no katsa fayili leyi nga khoasiki.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.ve: Dzhianani Vhona u itela u vula tokumente yo layishiwaho. U sedzwa ha u ita u shuma hu nga si kateli faele ine ya khoaswa.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.ss: Chafata Buka kuvula idokhumenti lelayishiwe. Kuhlolwa lokwenziwa ngokuzenzakalela kungase kungabi nefayela lelingakhoswa.

Use the person's @handle from their prof.af: Gebruik die persoon se @handle vanaf hul profiel, of hul gebruiker-ID as jy dit van 'n bespreking het.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.zu: Sebenzisa i-@handle yomuntu kusuka kuphrofayili yakhe, noma i-user ID uma unayo kusuka ekubhukeni.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.xh: Sebenzisa i-@handle yomntu kwiprofayile yakhe, okanye i-user ID ukuba unayo ukusuka ekubhukishweni.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.st: Sebelisa @handle ea motho ho tsoa profaeleng ea hae, kapa user ID haeba u e na le eona ho tsoa booking.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.nso: Šomiša @handle ya motho go tšwa profaeleng ya gagwe, goba user ID ge o e na le yona go tšwa go booking.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.tn: Dirisa @handle ya motho go tswa mo profaeleng ya gagwe, kgotsa user ID fa o e na le yona go tswa mo booking.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.ts: Tirhisa @handle ya munhu ku suka eka profayili ya yena, kumbe user ID loko u ri na yona ku suka eka ku veka.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.ve: Shumisani @handle ya munhu u bva kha profayili yawe, kana user ID arali ni na yone u bva kha u vhiga.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.ss: Sebentisa i-@handle yalomuntfu kusuka kuphrofayili yakhe, noma i-user ID uma uyitfolile ekubhukeni.

Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.af: Voer die {{digits}}-syfer-kode in wat na jou foon gestuur is (geldig ongeveer {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.zu: Faka ikhodi enamadijithi angu-{{digits}} ethunyelwe efoni yakho (ivumelekile cishe ngemizuzu engu-{{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.xh: Ngenisa ikhowudi enamadijithi angu-{{digits}} ethunyelwe kwifowuni yakho (isebenza malunga nemizuzu engu-{{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.st: Kenya khoutu ea linomoro tse {{digits}} e rometsoeng ho fono ea hau (e nepahetseng ka {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.nso: Tsenya khoutu ya dinomoro tše {{digits}} ye e rometšwego go fono ya gago (e šoma mabapi le {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.tn: Tsenya khoutu ya dinomoro tse {{digits}} e e rometsweng go fono ya gago (e dira mabapi le {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.ts: Nghenisa khoutu ya tinomboro ta {{digits}} leyi rhumeriweke eka riqingho ra wena (yi tirha hi {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.ve: Dzhenisani khoutu ya nomboro dza {{digits}} yo rumelwaho luṱingoni lwanu (i shuma nga ha {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.ss: Faka ikhodi yemadijithi langu-{{digits}} letfumelwe lucingo lwakho (ivumelekile ngekwe-{{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).

The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.zu: Isalon izokuqinisekisa ngo-{{time}}. Uma kungenjalo, lesi sikhathi sikhululiwe futhi u-{{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.xh: Isalon iya kuqinisekisa ngo-{{time}}. Ukuba akunjalo, eli xesha likhululiwe kwaye u-{{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.st: Salon e tla netefatsa ka {{time}}. Haeba e sa netefatse, nako ena e lokolotsoe mme u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.nso: Salon e tla netefatša ka {{time}}. Ge e sa netefatše, nako ye e lokollotšwe gomme o {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.tn: Salon e tla netefatsa ka {{time}}. Fa e sa netefatse, nako eno e lokolotswe mme o {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.ts: Salon yi ta tiyisisa hi {{time}}. Loko a swi endleki, nkarhi lowu wu siyiwa naswona u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.ve: Salon i do khwaṱhisedza nga {{time}}. Arali a zwi itei, naho iyi i siyiwa na ni {{refundLine}}.

Campaigns send through your own integrat.af: Veldtogte stuur via jou eie integrasies, so Beautonomi hef nie bemarkingskrediete nie.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.zu: Amakhampeni athunyelwa ngezixhumanisi zakho, ngakho i-Beautonomi ayikhokhisi amakhredithi okumaketha.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.xh: Amakhampeni athunyelwa ngezixhumanisi zakho, ke i-Beautonomi ayihlawulisi amakhredithi okuthengisa.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.st: Mats'olo a romelwa ka likopanyo tsa hau, ka hona Beautonomi ha e lefise likredithi tsa papatso.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.nso: Mats'olo a romelwa ka dikopanyo tša gago, ka fao Beautonomi ga e lefise dikredithi tša papatšo.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.tn: Mats'olo a romelwa ka dikopanyo tsa gago, ka jalo Beautonomi ga e lefise dikredithi tsa papatso.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.ts: Tikhampeni ti rhumeriwa hi swihlanganisi swa wena, hikwalaho Beautonomi a yi hakisi tikhrediti ta makete.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.ve: Khampeni dzi rumelwa nga u hlanganisa hwanu, zwino Beautonomi a i badeli tikhrediti dza u rengisa.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.ss: Emakhempeni atfumelwa ngekuhlanganisa kwakho, ngakho i-Beautonomi ayikhokhisi emakhredithi ekumaketha.

No product order was linked yet. If prod.zu: Ayikho i-oda yemikhiqizo exhunyiwe okwamanje. Uma imikhiqizo ikhona kule vakashe, zama futhi noma uxhumane nokusekela.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.xh: Akukho odara yemveliso idityanisiweyo okwangoku. Ukuba iimveliso zikhona kule ndibano, zama kwakhona okanye uqhagamshelane nenkxaso.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.st: Ha ho odara ea lihlahisoa e hokahileng hajoale. Haeba lihlahisoa li teng lets'eleng lena, leka hape kapa ikopanye le tšehetso.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.nso: Ga go na odara ya sehlahiswa e kgokagantšwego bjale. Ge dihlahiswa di lego letšeleng le, leka gape goba o ikopanye le thekgo.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.tn: Ga go na odara ya sehlahiswa e e kgokagantsweng jaanong. Fa dithoto di le mo keteleng eno, leka gape kgotsa o ikopanye le thekgo.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.ts: A ku na odara ya swilo leyi hlanganisiweke sweswi. Loko swilo swi kona eka ndzawulo leyi, ringeta nakambe kumbe tihlanganisa na mpfuno.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.ve: A hu na odara ya zwifhiwa yo hlanganiswaho zwino. Arali zwifhiwa zwi kha u dzhena uhu, lingedzeni hafhu kana kwamani na thuso.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.ss: Ayikho i-oda yemikhiqizo lehlanganisiwe okwamanje. Uma imikhiqizo ikhona kule vakashe, zama futsi noma tihlangana nekusita.

Add a serial number from your device lab.af: Voeg 'n reeksnommer van jou toestel-etiket of aktiverings-e-pos by om kaartbetalings te begin aanvaar.
Add a serial number from your device lab.zu: Engeza inombolo ye-serial esuka kulebula yedivayisi noma i-imeyili yokuvula ukuze uqale ukwamukela izinkokhelo zekhadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.xh: Yongeza inombolo ye-serial esuka kwilebula yedivayisi okanye i-imeyili yokuvula ukuze uqale ukwamkela iintlawulo zekhadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.st: Kenya nomoro ea serial ho tsoa leibole ea sesebelisoa kapa lengolo-tsoibila la ho qala ho amohela litefiso tsa karete.
Add a serial number from your device lab.nso: Oketša nomoro ya serial go tšwa go leibole ya sesebediswa goba imeile ya go thoma go amogela ditefiso tša karete.
Add a serial number from your device lab.tn: Oketsa nomoro ya serial go tswa mo leiboleng ya sedirisiwa kgotsa imeile ya go simolola go amogela ditefiso tsa karete.
Add a serial number from your device lab.ts: Engetela nomoro ya serial ku suka eka leibole ya xitirhisiwa kumbe imeyili ya ku sungula ku amukela mali ya tikhadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.ve: Engedzani nomoro ya serial u bva kha leibole ya tshishumiswa kana imeile ya u thoma u amukela u badela khadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.ss: Faka inombolo ye-serial esuka kulebula yedivayisi noma i-imeyili yekuvula kute ucale kwamukela tinkhokhelo temakhadi.

Cancellation or refund affects stock and.af: Kansellasie of terugbetaling beïnvloed voorraad en uitbetalings. Gebruik wanneer daar 'n probleem met hierdie bestelling is.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.zu: Ukukhansela noma ukubuyisela kuthinta isitokhu nezinkokhelo. Sebenzisa lapho kunenkinga nale odara.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.xh: Ukurhoxisa okanye ukubuyisela kuchaphazela isitokhu nezinkokhelo. Sebenzisa xa kukho ingxaki nale odara.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.st: Ho hlakola kapa ho khutlisa chelete ho ama stock le litefiso. Sebelisa ha ho na bothata ka odara ena.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.nso: Go khansela goba go bušetša tefo go ama stock le ditefelo. Šomiša ge go na bothata ka odara ye.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.tn: Go khansela kgotsa go busetsa tefo go ama stock le ditefelo. Dirisa fa go na bothata ka odara eno.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.ts: Ku khansela kumbe ku vuyisela mali swi khumba stock na mali leyi hakeriwaka. Tirhisa loko ku na xiphiqo na odara leyi.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.ve: U khansela kana u vhuyisela mali zwi khumba stock na u bvisa mali. Shumisani musi hu na bothata na odara iyi.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.ss: Kukhansela noma kubuyisela kuchaphazela sitokhu netinkhokhelo. Sebentisa lapho kunenkinga nale odara.

The first appointment is on the calendar.af: Die eerste afspraak is op die kalender. Gebruik jou kaartmasjien om betaling te voltooi.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.zu: I-aphoyintimenti yokuqala iku-khalenda. Sebenzisa umshini wakho wamakhadi ukuze uqedele inkokhelo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.xh: Idinga lokuqala likwi-khalenda. Sebenzisa umshini wakho wamakhadi ukuze ugqibezele intlawulo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.st: Kopano ea pele e almanakeng. Sebelisa mochini oa hau oa likarete ho qetella tefo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.nso: Peeletšo ya mathomo e almanakeng. Šomiša mochini wa gago wa dikarete go phetha tefo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.tn: Peelanonako ya ntlha e mo almanakeng. Dirisa mochini wa gago wa dikarete go fetsa tefo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ts: Ku hlangana ka sungula swi kona eka kalendara. Tirhisa muchini wa wena wa tikhadi ku hetisa ku hakela.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ve: U vhewa ha u thoma hu kha kalenda. Shumisani muchini wanu wa khadi u fhedza u badela.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ss: Sikhathi sokuqala sikukhalenda. Sebentisa umshini wakho wemakhadi kucedzela inkokhelo.{{extra}}

This row comes from weekly hours or loca.af: Hierdie ry kom van weeklikse ure of liggingure. Voeg 'n datumspesifieke skof by om dit te ignoreer.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.zu: Lo mugqa uvela emahoreni eviki noma emahoreni endaweni. Engeza ishifi elihambisana nosuku ukuze ulibalekele.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.xh: Lo mqolo uvela kwiiyure zeveki okanye kwiiyure zendawo. Yongeza ishifi enomhla othile ukuze uyibalekele.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.st: Mola ona o tsoa lihorong tsa beke kapa lihorong tsa sebaka. Kenya shift ea letsatsi leo ho e fetola.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.nso: Mola wo o tšwa dihorong tša beke goba dihorong tša lefelo. Oketša shift ya letšatši leo go e fetola.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.tn: Mola ono o tswa mo dihorong tsa beke kgotsa dihorong tsa lefelo. Oketsa shift ya letsatsi leo go e fetola.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.ts: Layini leyi yi huma eka tiawara ta vhiki kumbe tiawara ta ndhawu. Engetela shift ya siku ra siku ku yi tlula.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.ve: Layini iyi i bva kha tiawara dza vhiki kana tiawara dza fhethu. Engedzani shift ya ḓuvha ra ḓuvha u itela u i shandukisa.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.ss: Lomugqa uvela emahoreni eveliki noma emahoreni endzaweni. Faka ishifi lesihambisana nelilanga kute uyibalekele.

Recurring appointments require a plan th.af: Herhalende afsprake vereis 'n plan wat hierdie funksie insluit. Gradeer op onder Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.zu: Izikhathi eziphindaphindayo zidinga uhlelo oluhlanganisa lesi sici. Thuthukisa ngaphansi kwe-Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.xh: Iindibano eziphindaphindayo zifuna isicwangciso esiquka esi sici. Nyukela ngaphansi kwe-Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.st: Likopano tse pheta-phetaang li hloka moralo o kenyelletsang karolo ena. Nyolosa tlasa Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.nso: Dipeeletšo tše di phetago di nyaka leano le le akaretšago karolo ye. Nyolola ka fase ga Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.tn: Dipeelano tse di pheta-phetaang di tlhoka thulaganyo e e akaretsang karolo eno. Tlhatlosa fa tlase ga Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.ts: Swihlangano leswi pfuxetiwaka swi lava pulani leyi katsaka xitirhisiwa lexi. Hundzuluxa ehansi ka Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.ve: U vhiga hu pfuxaho hu ṱoḓea pulane ine ya katela tshitshitshi itshi. Shandukisani fhasi ha Subscription.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.ss: Tikhathi letiphindaphindako tidzinga luhlelo loluhlanganisa lesici. Thuthukisa ngaphansi kwe-Subscription.

Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.af: Soek, los 'n speld op die kaart, of gebruik huidige ligging — wysig dan die reëls hieronder indien nodig.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.zu: Sesha, wehle iphinhi emepini, noma usebenzise indawo yamanje — bese uhlela imigqa ngezansi uma kudingeka.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.xh: Khangela, wehle iphinhi kwimephu, okanye usebenzise indawo yangoku — uze uhlele imiqolo ngezansi ukuba kufuneka.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.st: Batla, beha pine 'mapeng, kapa sebelisa sebaka sa hajoale — ebe u fetola mela ka tlase haeba ho hlokahala.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.nso: Nyaka, bea pine 'mapeng, goba o šomiše lefelo la bjale — gomme o fetole mela ka fase ge go nyakega.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.tn: Batla, bea pine mo 'mapeng, kgotsa o dirise lefelo la jaanong — mme o fetole mela fa fase fa go tlhokega.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.ts: Lava, veka pin eka mapu, kumbe tirhisa ndhawu ya sweswi — u lulamisa milayini laha hansi loko swi laveka.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.ve: Sedzani, vheani pin kha mapu, kana ni shumise fhethu ha zwino — ni lulamisa milayini afha fhasi arali zwi khou todea.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.ss: Sesha, wehle iphinhi emepini, noma usebentise indzawo yamanje — bese ulungisa imigca ngezansi uma kudzingeka.

Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.af: Standaard SA VAT-koers is 15%. Dit word outomaties op alle diens- en produkpryse toegepas.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.zu: Izinga le-VAT le-SA elijwayelekile lingu-15%. Lisebenziswa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuzo zonke izintengo zesevisi nemikhiqizo.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.xh: Ireyithi ye-VAT ye-SA eqhelekileyo yi-15%. Isetyenziswa ngokuzenzekelayo kuzo zonke iixabiso zeenkonzo nemveliso.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.st: Sekhahla sa VAT sa SA se tloaelehileng ke 15%. Se sebelisoa ka bo eona lithekong tsohle tsa litšebeletso le lihlahisoa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.nso: Sekhahla sa VAT sa SA se tlwaelegilego ke 15%. Se šomišwa ka go iketla dithekong tšohle tša ditirelo le dihlahiswa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.tn: Sekhahla sa VAT sa SA se se tlwaelegileng ke 15%. Se dirisiwa ka tsona ditlhwatlweng tsotlhe tsa ditirelo le dithoto.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.ts: Xiyimo xa VAT xa SA lexi tolovelekeke i 15%. Xi tirhisiwa hi ku tirhisa hi xoxe eka minxavo hinkwayo ya vukorhokeri na swilo.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.ve: Vhuyelwa ha VAT ha SA ha u thoma i 15%. Hu shumiswa hi yone kha mitengo yothe ya tshumelo na zwifhiwa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.ss: Silinganiso se-VAT se-SA lesijwayelekile singu-15%. Sisetjentiswa ngokuzenzakalela kuyo yonke intengo yetinsita nemikhiqizo.

Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.af: Hou hierdie spanwerk, of open jou eie Beautonomi-besigheid. Jy kan enige tyd tussen hulle wissel.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.zu: Gcina lo msebenzi weqembu, noma uvule ibhizinisi lakho le-Beautonomi. Ungashintsha phakathi kwabo noma nini.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.xh: Gcina lo msebenzi weqela, okanye uvule ishishini lakho le-Beautonomi. Ungatshintsha phakathi kwabo nangaliphi na ixesha.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.st: Boloka mosebetsi ona oa sehlopha, kapa bula khoebo ea hau ea Beautonomi. O ka fetola pakeng tsa tsona neng kapa neng.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.nso: Boloka mošomo wo wa sehlopha, goba bula kgwebo ya gago ya Beautonomi. O ka fetola gare ga tšona nako efe goba efe.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.tn: Boloka tiro eno ya sehlopha, kgotsa o bule kgwebo ya gago ya Beautonomi. O ka fetola gare ga tsona nako nngwe le nngwe.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.ts: Hlayisa ntirho lowu wa ntlawa, kumbe pfula bindzuri bya wena bya Beautonomi. U nga ha cinca exikarhi ka tona nkarhi wun'wana na wun'wana.

How you compensate your staff or contrac.af: Hoe jy jou personeel of kontrakteurs vergoed. Jy kan dit enige tyd in Payroll-instellings verfyn.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.zu: Indlela ohlela ngayo abasebenzi bakho noma abaqashi. Ungakuthinta noma nini kuzilungiselelo ze-Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.xh: Indlela owabonelela ngayo abasebenzi bakho okanye abaqeshi. Ungayilungisa nangaliphi na ixesha kwiisetingi ze-Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.st: Mokhoa oo o lefisang ka eena basebetsi kapa baqapi. O ka o ntlafatsa neng kapa neng litlhophisong tsa Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.nso: Mokgwa wo o lefago ka wona basebetsi goba baqapi. O ka o ntlafatša nako efe goba efe go dipeakanyo tša Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.tn: Tsela e o lefang ka yone basebetsi kgotsa baqapi. O ka e tokafatsa nako nngwe le nngwe mo dipeakanyong tsa Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.ts: Ndlela leyi u hakelaka vadyondzi kumbe vatirhi va nkarhi. U nga yi antswisa nkarhi wun'wana na wun'wana eka swileriso swa Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.ve: Nḓila ine na badela ngayo vhashumi kana vha contract. Ni nga i antswisa tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe kha zwiitisi zwa Payroll.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.ss: Indlela laphatsa ngayo basebenti bakho noma baphatsi. Ungayilungisa noma nini kumatsetelo e-Payroll.

Revenue is recognized provider earnings.ts: Rendhawu is recognized mupfuneti earnings net of nxavo clawendzhakus — same basis as Xavisos Nkatsakanyo — split by vukorhokeri line ntsengo avelana.
Revenue is recognized provider earnings.ve: Refhethu is recognized muneḓi earnings net of mbuyiso clawmurahus — same basis as Thengisos Khaṱhulo — split by tshumelo line mutengo kovhela.
